prompts.BronzeAge:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Russian-culture Bronze Age OVERLAND TRADER static master for the historical RTS Age of Fronts.
Image 1 is ONLY a role/layout and painted-material reference: ONE civilian merchant pulls ONE two-wheeled cargo handcart and the whole unit faces screen-down. Image 2 is the approved Russian Bronze Age cargo boat, ONLY a style, regional material and trade-goods reference. Create a NEW land trader, not an edit to either source.
Camera: straight overhead orthographic, exactly perpendicular to the ground. Show the top of the cart and the merchant's hair crown and shoulders, with compressed overhead anatomy. Avoid the front-oblique angle and visible face of Image 1. Travel direction precisely SCREEN-DOWN; cart is behind the merchant toward screen-top. No isometric perspective, ground, cast shadow outside the unit, scenery, label, watermark or text. One centered complete sprite with generous transparent margin; no clipping.
Subject: one adult civilian merchant pulling a compact rectangular two-wheel wooden freight handcart by its two straight wooden shafts. Both hands visibly grip the two shafts, arms attach to shoulders naturally. One head, two arms, two connected legs and two feet, relaxed balanced walking-ready pose, no exaggerated stride. Two believable SOLID WOODEN DISC wheels on a single crosswise axle, seen edge-on from above at the left and right sides; no iron tires, metal wheel rings or modern spoked bicycle wheels. Sturdy adzed oak frame and pale birch boards with physically connected mortise joints, bast/rawhide lashings, clear axle support, no floating rails.
Four large secured cargo masses in the open cart: one broad cream hide-wrapped bale, one woven grain basket, one wicker basket holding a few visible dull copper/bronze cast chunks, and one terracotta jar with a dark circular mouth. Thick crossed bast ties anchor everything to the frame. Cargo covers most of the cart so the commercial role reads at 24-48 pixels. No weapons, armor, shields, banner, canopy, horse, donkey, pack animal, extra person or extra wagon.
Merchant clothing is a simple undyed pale flax or hide smock with a reddish ochre waist wrap, brown plain leg coverings and simple hide footwear. Short dark hair, no medieval hood, fur hat, helmet, fantasy jewelry or elaborate decoration. Restrained warm wood, cream, ochre and copper palette echoes the approved Russian vessels. Regional prehistoric forest/river inspiration; a gameplay interpretation, not a claim of an exact excavated human-pulled cart.
Polished crisp painterly game art with believable timber thickness, clean connected construction, warm upper-left light and a few bold large forms. Match Image 2's material finish. The cart plus merchant form an instantly legible long cargo-carrier silhouette. Fully transparent RGBA background. Square high-resolution canvas. One complete STATIC master, no animation sheets.
prompts.StoneAge:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Russian-culture STONE AGE overland trader static master for Age of Fronts.
Image 1 is the new Russian Bronze Age merchant, only a painterly style, anatomy, screen-down facing and light reference. Image 2 is the approved Russian Stone Age cargo boat, only a regional materials and trade-goods reference. Create a NEW earlier-age trader, not a cropped copy or edited source.
Subject explicitly chosen by the user: ONE lone civilian merchant carrying a LOADED BACK BASKET. No wagon, wheels, drag frame, animal or companion.
Camera exactly vertical overhead orthographic, perpendicular to the ground. Travel direction precisely SCREEN-DOWN. Show the crown of short dark hair, shoulders, top of the load and naturally foreshortened connected limbs. No face-forward portrait angle, isometric camera, ground, water, scenery or cast shadow outside the unit. One complete centered transparent sprite with generous margins, no cropped feet or basket.
The merchant wears a simple dark reddish-brown stitched hide tunic, rough rawhide waist tie, plain hide leg wraps and closed simple hide footwear. Bare head, no helmet, medieval hood, fur cap, armor, flags, insignia or weapons. Exactly one head, two arms, two hands, two connected legs, two feet. A restrained balanced walking-ready stance, not a dramatic attack or huge stretched stride.
A large sturdy woven willow/bast BACK BASKET is strapped snugly against the upper back behind the shoulders, toward screen-top, visibly carried by TWO broad rawhide shoulder straps. Both hands grasp the straps close to the torso to balance the load. No basket floating behind the merchant, and no gap between carrier and pack. Its broad golden wicker silhouette is the dominant commercial cue. The basket contains THREE large trade-goods masses, lashed securely with thick crossed bast cords: a broad pale rolled hide bundle, a russet woven goods pouch, and a shallow basket of a few LARGE clean grey flint cores/chunks. Shapes must read at 24-48 pixels; avoid tiny scattered clutter. No copper, bronze, iron, gold, steel, pottery rack, modern backpack buckles or modern crates.
The earlier Stone Age construction is rougher and simpler than Image 1 but just as polished in art clarity: hand-worked hide, broad basket weaving, rough cord ties. Use the warm brown, cream and ochre material palette of Image 2. Regional prehistoric forest/river inspiration for this game's Russian civilization, not later national dress or an exact recovered individual.
Crisp high-quality painterly RTS sprite, warm upper-left lighting, clearly joined straps and limbs, simple strong silhouette, physically plausible load carried by the shoulders. Same visual quality as the approved Russian boats and the new Bronze Age trader. Fully transparent RGBA background, square high-resolution canvas, one complete STATIC master, no text or animation frames.
prompts.BronzeAgeWheelCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY the wheel rolling treads of this approved Russian Bronze Age handcart merchant.
There is a small raised RECTANGULAR BLOCK on the upward-facing rolling surface in the middle of EACH wheel, one at left and one at right. These make the wheels bump as they roll. REMOVE BOTH raised rectangular tread blocks completely and replace each tiny patch with continuous smooth rounded wooden tread that matches the adjoining grain, lighting and surface curvature. The finished wheel treads are uninterrupted smooth wood from end to end: no proud blocks, studs, raised cross bands, peg heads, rectangular patches, steps, bolts or lumps on the rolling circumference.
Keep the round AXLE HUB projecting horizontally from the OUTSIDE CENTER of each wheel. Those side hubs are functional and do not contact the ground; preserve them and the continuous axle support. Keep the wheel shapes, widths, positions and two-wheel count unchanged.
Every other pixel and design is invariant: the one merchant, hair crown, pale stitched smock, ochre waist wrap, arms and hand grips, connected legs and footwear, two straight pulling shafts, cart frame, lashings, four secured cargo masses, copper/bronze chunks, pale hide bale, grain basket and terracotta jar. Same straight overhead camera, screen-down facing, original canvas size, source framing, colors, crisp painterly quality and warm upper-left light. No added objects or labels. Keep the true transparent RGBA background and all margins. One complete static master.
